description: Claude Code's /config panel as a newer Claude Code draws it: the same five tabs (Settings Status Config Usage Stats) under the dialog's top rule and a Search settings box, but a ❯ list of setting names and values with no '↓ N more' and a new footer, 'Enter/Space to change · / to search · Esc to close'. The panel rule keyed on the old footer's '↑ to tabs', so it stopped firing and the pane sat in Needs you with every setting as an answer button. The panel is now read by structure (a 3+ label tab strip, a search box or a ❯ name/value row, and a last-row footer whose Esc closes rather than cancels), so the pane is idle. Real capture (tmux-rc, 2026-10-13), only the cwd changed.
